name: Carton House - A Fairmont Hotel
positioning: Historic manor house hotel on a 1,100-acre estate in Maynooth, County Kildare, Ireland
best_for: Travelers who like history and walking on park land
Guests arriving by car who want free parking on site

facts.text: The house was formerly the home of the Earls of Kildare and dates back to the 1700s.
The property covers 1,100 acres with expansive park land and walking paths.
Dublin International Airport is 32km from Carton House via the M50/M4 motorways.
The hotel can arrange a private airport transfer for guests, with quotations available on request.
Carton House is in Maynooth, on the Western Suburban Railway Line, which serves three Dublin city centre stations.
A taxi from Maynooth Station to Carton House takes approximately 5 minutes.
Carton House offers complimentary car parking on resort for all guests and visitors.
Valet parking is available on request for an additional charge.

highlights.text: The house was the filming location for the BBC miniseries "The Aristocrats".
The grounds include bluebell-lined pathways, small streams and a medieval tower.
The original period details of the manor house are combined with contemporary luxury touches.

considerations.text: The hotel is in Maynooth, 32km from Dublin International Airport by motorway; a private transfer is quoted on request.
Valet parking carries an additional charge; self-parking is complimentary.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing for the luxury estate experience.
